info.title: HOTEL PMS SAAS - Phase 5 implemented operations
info.description: Operations implemented in Phase 5 (rates, availability, inventory guarantee, exposure). Only implemented operations are listed. Missing operations from the planned v1 contract remain unimplemented.

Error.description: Fixed error code, localized message key, correlation id and bounded details without secrets

tax_policy_version.description: Accepted for forward compatibility; tax policies are owned by Phase 8 and ignored until then.

201.description: Rate plan created in DRAFT status

200.description: Rate plan updated. Policy changes append an immutable policy version.

post.description: Atomic batch inside one property lock. Zero price requires the plan free policy. Fractional IDR is rejected later at exposure publish when the channel does not accept it; no silent rounding.

200.description: All cells applied or none; property inventory_version incremented once
Active rate plans and their nightly prices in the requested range

post.description: Advisory result computed under the property lock with a bounded search budget. AVAILABLE is not a guarantee; a hold revalidates under the same lock.

200.description: Availability offers; UNDETERMINED means the search budget was exhausted without side effects

post.description: Freezes nightly prices into an immutable quote snapshot used by holds.
Fixes resources and periods for every item under one property lock; all items or none. Expired holds are released before allocating, using database time.

200.description: Active and expired holds with their allocations

post.description: PLANNED blocks reject an overlap with an active commitment; EMERGENCY blocks keep the commitment and create a disruption, and additionally require maintenance.emergency.

201.description: Block created; emergency blocks report the disruptions they opened

200.description: Blocks and disruptions in the property

post.description: Standing OOO/OOS maintenance state; setting a non-NONE state additionally requires maintenance.emergency. Temporary windows remain represented by blocks.
Computes allowed and the reason codes under the property lock with a fresh inventory version; the preview expires and publishes exactly once.

200.description: Preview result with preview_version bound to inventory_version

post.description: Reserves the exposed resources immediately and queues absolute snapshots. Accepted for processing; not proof of provider completion.

202.description: Exposure queued and its resources protected immediately

post.description: Sends stop-sell first but does not release the protected resources until channel evidence is reconciled.

STOP_SELL inserts a named restriction; OPEN closes one restriction and reports the derived effective state, which stays closed while another reason, block, commitment or unresolved withdrawal remains.

200.description: Derived sale state after the change

get.description: Separates queued, provider accepted, channel verified and unknown; HTTP acceptance is not channel verification.

post.description: Advances publishing exposures to ACTIVE on provider acceptance while preserving allocations. Withdrawal release is BLOCKED_CAPABILITY (RELEASE_PROOF_NOT_IMPLEMENTED): transport acceptance and CHANNEL_VERIFIED alone do not prove reconciliation of booking revisions through a certified cutoff. Completed transport moves withdrawal to RECONCILING and retains allocations; released is always zero until an authorized complete proof mechanism is implemented.
